title: Show in Call Graph
summary: Opens the call graph rooted at the symbol represented by a Structure-tree node
intro: Read this when you are looking at a symbol in the Structure outline and want to see who calls it or what it calls: right-click the node to open the call graph rooted there.

surfaces.caption: Show in Call Graph
steps: Open the Structure form (drag-lint > Show Structure)
Right-click a node in the tree and choose Show in Call Graph
The call graph rooted at that symbol opens

surfaces.usage: drag-lint reverse-calltree --qname <X> [--direction callers|callees] [--depth N] [--format text|json|dot|mermaid] [--json] --db PATH [--db ...] (N-deep call tree; callers=who calls X (default), callees=what X calls; cycle-guarded)

questions.ask: Who calls the symbol I see in the Structure outline, and what does it call?
questions.command: Structure form > Show in Call Graph
